about: Cloud engineer with a long track record of building and operating resilient platform infrastructure for high-traffic services. I enjoy turning brittle manual processes into automated, observable systems that teams can trust. Comfortable owning architecture decisions end to end while mentoring engineers along the way.

experiences.description: Lead the platform engineering group responsible for the company's multi-region infrastructure and internal developer tooling. I drive migrations toward self-service provisioning and own the reliability targets for our most critical customer-facing services. Much of my time goes to standardizing how teams deploy and observe their workloads.

Designed and maintained the shared infrastructure layer that hosted dozens of product teams. I introduced automated provisioning pipelines and tightened cost governance across environments. Worked closely with security to bake compliance checks directly into the delivery flow.

Operated the production environment for a fast-growing logistics platform and improved its uptime through better failover design. I rebuilt the on-call runbooks and reduced repetitive incident toil with targeted automation. Also led the rollout of a centralized monitoring stack.

Built continuous delivery pipelines that let product teams ship daily with confidence. I containerized several legacy applications and standardized how they were configured across stages. Spent considerable effort closing gaps between development and operations practices.

Managed hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premise hardware and early cloud workloads. I automated routine maintenance tasks and scripted the provisioning of new service nodes. Helped the team plan a phased move of stateful services into managed environments.

Supported the operations team in keeping internal servers and networking healthy. I handled patching cycles, backup verification, and first-line infrastructure troubleshooting. This role gave me the operational grounding that shaped how I think about reliability today.
